data.failure_policy: STOP new admission on any gate, timeout, stale hash, unknown or pending custody, failed text/usage/actual-ID/trace/counter/NFS gate or post-idle. Never drop/replace a pair. Retain five paired blocks, ten lifecycles, 120 requests and 50 measured QA, including censored and unissued slots. Cancellation retains maintained subreaper cleanup authority.
data.goodput: Per-arm sum of actual completion_tokens from measured eligible QA / sum of actual client request_e2e_seconds for all five measured QA slots. Only complete quality/custody-qualified arms get a number; partial/failed/unissued arms remain null, not zero latency or silently excluded.
data.interpretation: CPU-only separate V3 design, not execution or GPU quality; no binary copied or committed
data.interval: Exact enumerated paired-block bootstrap, resample five block log ratios with replacement (5^5=3125), nearest-rank 2.5%/97.5% percentiles, exp endpoints. Only if all five pairs qualify; otherwise no aggregate estimate or interval. Exploratory descriptive n=5, not coverage-guaranteed confidence or significance.
data.order_algorithm: Sort P1..P5 by SHA256('20261015:' + block); first three are blocking-first, other two lookahead-first; execute blocks P1..P5
data.primary_estimand: Median across the five block-level log ratios log(lookahead/blocking), each arm represented by its median of five measured-QA client E2E seconds; report exp(median) and 1-exp(median). TTFT and quality-qualified goodput use the same block pairing as prespecified secondary outcomes.
